title: Taguig gov't disputes Lacson’s illegal reclamation claims

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Taguig City government on Saturday denied involvement in alleged illegal reclamation activities at the Taguig side of Laguna Lake, saying the property inspected by government agencies was not being possessed or used by the city. The city government said the area shown in a video released by Sen. Panfilo Lacson involved a parcel of land claimed by several private individuals and a neighborhood association. “Contrary to what Senator Lacson wants the public to believe, the area shown in the peddled video does not involve any land presently possessed and used by the City of Taguig,” it said […]...
